title: Making the Cloud and AI Development Act (CADA) a foundation for European sovereignty, resilience, and innovation
excerpt: Sovereignty matters to Oracle. For almost 50 years, we have worked with governments and public-sector organizations across Europe to run their critical workloads and deliver essential services. Helping these customers realize the benefits of cloud and AI is central to our business: strengthening public services, supporting the people who deliver them, and improving citizens’ lives. […]
